dialogue.content: こんばんわ。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: ご準備が宜しければ少し早いですが始めさせて頂いても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you're ready, may we start a bit early?

dialogue.content: はい何か希望のテーマはありますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, is there a particular theme you'd like to focus on?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お任せでお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm happy to leave it up to you.

dialogue.content: わかりました。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Understood. Let's begin.

dialogue.content: では、よろしくおねがいします。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Alright then, let's get started. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: お願いします。彼とうまくいかなくて
dialogue.English: Well, things aren't going well with my boyfriend.

dialogue.content: 彼さんと、上手くいかないのですね。お辛いですよね。どのような感じなのか聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see—things aren't going well with your boyfriend. That must be painful. Would you tell me more about what it's been like?

dialogue.content: はい私の方は結婚したいと言ったのですが俺みたいなのはやめた方がいいよ、って言われてしまって
dialogue.English: Yes. I told him I wanted to get married, but he said, 'You'd be better off not marrying someone like me.'

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・ショックですよね。やめといたほうがといわれても納得いかない感じですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... That must have been a shock. It's hard to just accept that, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですねー。
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: なんていうか、どうしたらいいかわかりません
dialogue.English: I mean, I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、よく分からなくなりますよね。やめといた方が良いと言われてどのようにお答えになられたのですか？
dialogue.English: I understand—it can leave you feeling at a loss. How did you respond when he told you that you should give up on him?

dialogue.content: 私としては一緒にいてとてもくつろげているというか、うまくいくと思うから別れたくないと
dialogue.English: I told him that I feel very comfortable with him and that I think we can make it work, so I don't want to break up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 彼さんはどのような返答をされたのでしょう・・
dialogue.English: And what was his response to that?

dialogue.content: はい彼の方はマージャンやったり遊び人だから君にはもったいない、みたいなことを言ってて
dialogue.English: Well, he said something like he plays mahjong and fools around, so he's not good enough for me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: たぶん、女遊びもしているかも、と思わないでもないんですけど
dialogue.English: And I can't help but think he might be seeing other women, too.

dialogue.content: そうお思いになるという事はきっとそうゆう影もお感じなのでしょうね・・とてもお辛い状況に思えます・・
dialogue.English: The fact that you think that suggests you might be sensing something... It sounds like a very painful situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 会う頻度が減っているせいで私の妄想なのかもしれないけど
dialogue.English: Maybe it's just my imagination because we're not seeing each other as often.

dialogue.content: そこを聞く勇気はなくて
dialogue.English: But I don't have the courage to ask him about it.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね・・不安とか傷つくとかこわいですものね。会う頻度は変わったりされたのでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: Yes, that's understandable... It's scary to feel anxious or get hurt. Has the frequency of your meetings changed?

dialogue.content: そうですね。数も減ってますし彼から誘ってくれることがだいぶ無い感じです
dialogue.English: It has. We're seeing each other less, and it feels like he rarely asks me out anymore.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・勇気を出して結婚を切り出すほど好きなのに、そんな態度は辛すぎます。
dialogue.English: I see... To be treated like that when you love him enough to bravely bring up marriage must be incredibly painful.

dialogue.content: はい自分でも振られそうで不安だから結婚ていう約束が欲しかっただけだと思うんです
dialogue.English: Yes... I think I just wanted the promise of marriage because I was anxious he might break up with me.

dialogue.content: 約束欲しいです。やはり、彼から何か言ってほしいと思ったり期待してしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Of course you want that commitment. It's natural to hope he'll say something reassuring.

dialogue.content: はい。今すぐするか？と聞かれたらまあ、できればしたいんですけど、
dialogue.English: Yes. If you asked me if I wanted to get married right now, well, I would if I could, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それは、約束があれば時間をかけて決めればいいと思っているので
dialogue.English: I feel that if we had that promise, we could take our time to figure things out.

dialogue.content: かといって結婚しないとわかっている相手と、付き合い続けたら結婚できないですよね？
dialogue.English: But on the other hand, if I keep dating someone who I know won't marry me, I'll never get married, right?

dialogue.content: 安心の元でじっくりという考えとてもしっかりされていて素晴らしい奥様になられると思います。そうですね、もしかしたら結婚を真剣に考えてくれるのではと思われますか？
dialogue.English: Wanting to take your time with that security is a very solid way of thinking. I think you'd make a wonderful wife. That said, do you think he might seriously consider marriage?

dialogue.content: 話した後の感じでは、この人はまだまだ遊びたいんだな、という感想だったんですけど・・・
dialogue.English: From how it felt after we talked, my impression was that he still wants to play around...

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょう。いいパパになりそうな気がするんですけどこれも妄想なのかも。
dialogue.English: I don't know. I have a feeling he'd be a good dad, but maybe that's just wishful thinking.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか・・そうお感じになられてるのですね！勇気を出して結婚を切り出して痛みにたえながら、どこかで彼さんは結婚にふみ混んでくれないと。だけど結婚した後の幸せな家族も・・
dialogue.English: I see... so that's how you feel. You gathered your courage to bring up marriage and are enduring this pain, hoping he'll commit. And at the same time, you can also picture a happy family after marriage...

dialogue.content: 想像されていて、心がとても悲しくなりますよね
dialogue.English: Imagining that must make your heart ache.

dialogue.content: 一緒にいてとても優しい人なのでそう思うのですが、彼には重荷なのかもしれません
dialogue.English: He's a very kind person when we're together, so that's why I think that, but maybe it's too much of a burden for him.

dialogue.content: 彼のは重荷、そうお感じなのですね。とても向き合っていらっしゃって真剣でいらっしゃる。
dialogue.English: You feel it's a burden for him. You're truly facing this and taking it very seriously.

dialogue.content: 私の家に遊びに来て家族とも会っているのでだいぶ肩透かしを喰らった感じ、というのはありますね
dialogue.English: Since he has come over to my place and met my family, I do feel quite let down.

dialogue.content: 肩透かし、というのは、もう少し詳しく教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a bit more about what you mean by 'let down'?

dialogue.content: すみません・・
dialogue.English: I'm sorry...

dialogue.content: 家族とも会ってくれたら期待してしまう・・
dialogue.English: When he meets your family, it's natural to have expectations...

dialogue.content: という事ですよね
dialogue.English: ...is that what you mean?

dialogue.content: そうです！真剣に付き合っている相手でもなければ彼女の実家に行くのって気がひけると思うんです
dialogue.English: Exactly! I would think a guy would be hesitant to go to his girlfriend's family home unless he was serious about the relationship.

dialogue.content: かといって私は彼のご家族には面識がないんですけどね…。
dialogue.English: But then again, I've never met his family...

dialogue.content: そうなんですか・・連れて行ってくれないのでしょうか・・とても複雑なお気持ちになり、悲しくもなりますよね。そんな今の彼さんをどんな風にお思いですか？
dialogue.English: Oh, is that so... He won't introduce you? That must make you feel very conflicted and sad. How do you feel about him right now, given all this?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、彼の家に行くのですが一軒家に1人で住んでてお兄さんもたまにしか帰ってこない、
dialogue.English: Well... I go to his house, and he lives alone in a single-family home. His older brother only comes back occasionally.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ご両親は、聞いてもどこにいるとか教えてくれなかったです。とにかく別の場所にいて家にはひとり、としか
dialogue.English: When I asked about his parents, he wouldn't tell me where they are. Just that they're somewhere else and he's at the house alone.

dialogue.content: これしか知らない相手と結婚しようとしている自分に今、驚いてます
dialogue.English: I'm surprised at myself now, for wanting to marry someone I know so little about.

dialogue.content: お母さんは看護婦さんでいつも家には居なかった、とは聞きました
dialogue.English: He did say his mother is a nurse and was rarely at home.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・彼さんにとても事情がおありなのでしょうかね？彼さんは自分にはもったいないと言われたことと、何か関係がおありなのでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: I see... I wonder if there's a complicated story there? Could it be related to why he said he's not good enough for you?

dialogue.content: そうですね…自分の気持ちばかりで彼の状況とか、わかってなかったのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: You may be right... I was so focused on my own feelings, I might not have understood his situation.

dialogue.content: 彼がその広い家にひとりで好きにやっている様なのででも、私はそこには入れないのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: It seems like he does as he pleases alone in that big house, and maybe there's no place for me in that life.

dialogue.content: 彼さんととてもうまくいってると感じておられたのに、もったいないの言葉がやはり引っかかってしまいます。
dialogue.English: Even though you felt things were going very well with him, his words 'you're too good for me' still stick with you.

dialogue.content: お父さんも教員でまじめに育てられた反動で遊んでいるのかなぁ、なんて思っていたのですが
dialogue.English: I had been thinking that maybe he was just rebelling and fooling around because his father was a teacher and he was raised strictly.

dialogue.content: 彼には私との家庭が想像できないのかもしれないですね…
dialogue.English: Maybe he just can't imagine having a family with me...

dialogue.content: そこには入れないのでしょうか・・すみません、個人的な思いですが私には彼さんが何かご事情があって、大好きな相談者さんをこんな事情のある自分とではとお思いになられたのではと思ってしまいました・・が、
dialogue.English: Is there really no room for you...? Forgive me for my personal opinion, but it occurred to me that maybe he has some circumstances, and he feels that someone like him, with those circumstances, isn't right for you, whom he loves... but...

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょう？そんなに優しい言葉を言ってもらうと泣けてきます
dialogue.English: I wonder... Hearing you say such kind words makes me want to cry.

dialogue.content: そんな予想ばかりしていては、優しい相談者さまですので、これから一緒にどうしていったらいいかを考えてみませんか？
dialogue.English: Rather than just speculating, since you are such a kind person, shall we think together about what you can do from here?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 家族にも会ってくれた彼さん、温かい相談者さんが眩しく思えて身を引こうとされていたら、
dialogue.English: If he met your family and is now trying to pull away because your warmth feels too bright for him...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここで、間違った選択をして後悔するのか、
dialogue.English: At this point, will you make a choice you might regret,

dialogue.content: 彼を少し信じて、ぶつかってみるか、
dialogue.English: or will you trust him a little and try to confront the issue,

dialogue.content: ぶつかって、前に進まれるのか
dialogue.English: confront it and move forward?

dialogue.content: どちらなら出来そうとかございますか？
dialogue.English: Which one feels more doable for you?

dialogue.content: うーん結婚の話をした時は、彼の方はドン引きっていう感じで私は結構アタックしてしまったので
dialogue.English: Hmm... When I talked about marriage, he seemed completely taken aback, and I think I came on pretty strong.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: びっくりされたのでしょうね
dialogue.English: He must have been surprised.

dialogue.content: もっと、話を聴いてあげなくてはいけないのかもと、今は思います
dialogue.English: Now I feel I should have listened to him more.

dialogue.content: びっくりというか、初めて切り出した訳でもなくて、私の責め立てる勢いがいけなかったのかも
dialogue.English: It's not just that he was surprised, as it wasn't the first time I'd brought it up. Maybe it was the forceful way I was pressing him that was the problem.

dialogue.content: そうお感じなのですね。とてもお強くて彼の事本当に思っておられて、前に進みたいお気持ちが伝わってきます
dialogue.English: That's how you feel. I can sense your strength, how much you truly care about him, and your desire to move forward.

dialogue.content: ふだんからほんわかしていて口下手なタイプなので。彼は。そこがいいんですけどでも、優柔不断かなぁ…
dialogue.English: He's usually very laid-back and not much of a talker. That's what I like about him, but maybe he's just indecisive...

dialogue.content: 相談者さんのやさしさや理解されている強さとが感じられます。話を聴いて差し上げて包み込んであげれるお方だと思うので、きっと彼さんの心にも勇気を吹き込まれるに違いないと思ってしまうのですがいかがでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: I can sense your kindness and the strength in your understanding. I believe you are someone who can listen to and embrace him, and I can't help but think that would give him courage. What do you think?

dialogue.content: なんだかスッキリしてきました。
dialogue.English: I feel much clearer now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！そう言って頂けて嬉しいです
dialogue.English: Thank you! I'm happy to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: 勇気もいると思いますが、心から応援しています。心から祈ってしまいます。
dialogue.English: I know it will take courage, but I am sincerely rooting for you. I'll be praying for the best.

dialogue.content: こちらこそとても大事なことに気がつかせてもらえてよかったです！
dialogue.English: Thank you, I'm glad you helped me realize something very important!

dialogue.content: 彼が話してくれるか分からないですが、もっと穏やかに接してみるようにします
dialogue.English: I don't know if he'll open up, but I'll try to approach him more gently.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。他に何かございませんでしょうか？また何か不安になられましたらいつでも来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Is there anything else? If you ever feel anxious again, please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Okay. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 終了ボタンを押させて頂いてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: May I press the end button now?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.
